title: OTelTraceBlake3IntegrationSchema
description: Standard schema for OpenTelemetry trace telemetry linked to BLAKE3 event-chain roots to guarantee unforgeability.

trace_id.description: W3C TraceID represented as a 32-character hexadecimal string.

event_chain_root.description: The BLAKE3 hash of the final event-chain state, attesting to the integrity of the entire trace.

spans.description: The sequential execution spans that form the deterministic telemetry timeline.

span_id.description: W3C SpanID represented as a 16-character hexadecimal string.

parent_span_id.description: W3C Parent SpanID or null if it is the root span.

span_name.description: Canonical activity label or operation name of the execution step.

start_time_unix_us.description: Start timestamp in integer microseconds since the Unix epoch.

end_time_unix_us.description: End timestamp in integer microseconds since the Unix epoch.

instruction_count.description: Cumulative guest instruction execution count at the end of this span.

blake3_receipt.description: The cumulative BLAKE3 receipt hash for this execution step, computed recursively as BLAKE3(PriorReceipt || SpanData).
